text: Mkpụrụedemede. N'ebe a, anyị ga-amụta mkpụrụedemede Bekee.
en: Letters. Here we learn the English letters.

text: Chọta foto. A ga-akpọ aha otu ihe, mgbe ahụ pịa foto ya.
en: Find the picture. The name of a thing will be said, then tap its picture.

text: Ide ihe. N'ebe a, anyị ga-amụta ide okwu Bekee, mkpụrụedemede n'otu n'otu.
en: Writing. Here we learn to write English words, letter by letter.

text: Họrọ otu ihe ọmụmụ, ka ị nụ ihe gbasara ya.
en: Pick a lesson, to hear more about it.

text: Lee mkpụrụedemede niile. Ka anyị mụta ha ìgwè n'ìgwè.
en: Here are all the letters. Let's learn them group by group.

text: Anụmanụ. Ihe ọmụmụ a bụ maka anụmanụ dị iche iche bi gburugburu anyị.
en: Animals. This lesson is about the different animals that live around us.

text: Ahụ. Ihe ọmụmụ a bụ maka akụkụ ahụ mmadụ dị iche iche.
en: The body. This lesson is about the different parts of the human body.

text: Nri. Ihe ọmụmụ a bụ maka nri dị iche iche anyị na-eri kwa ụbọchị.
en: Food. This lesson is about the different foods we eat every day.

text: Ihe ụlọ. Ihe ọmụmụ a bụ maka ihe anyị na-eji n'ụlọ.
en: Household things. This lesson is about the things used at home.

text: Okike. Ihe ọmụmụ a bụ maka ihe dị n'okike na gburugburu anyị.
en: Nature. This lesson is about the things in nature and our surroundings.

text: Ụgbọ njem. Ihe ọmụmụ a bụ maka ụgbọala na ihe ndị ọzọ anyị na-anya.
en: Vehicles. This lesson is about cars and the different things we ride.

text: Ugbu a, anyị ga-ahụ foto anụmanụ. Anyị ga-amụta aha ha n'asụsụ Bekee.
en: Now we'll see pictures of animals. We'll learn their names in English.

text: Ugbu a, anyị ga-ahụ foto akụkụ ahụ. Anyị ga-amụta aha ha n'asụsụ Bekee.
en: Now we'll see pictures of body parts. We'll learn their names in English.

text: Ugbu a, anyị ga-ahụ foto nri. Anyị ga-amụta aha ha n'asụsụ Bekee.
en: Now we'll see pictures of food. We'll learn their names in English.

text: Ugbu a, anyị ga-ahụ foto ihe ụlọ. Anyị ga-amụta aha ha n'asụsụ Bekee.
en: Now we'll see pictures of household things. We'll learn their names in English.

text: Ugbu a, anyị ga-ahụ foto ihe okike. Anyị ga-amụta aha ha n'asụsụ Bekee.
en: Now we'll see pictures of things in nature. We'll learn their names in English.

text: Ugbu a, anyị ga-amụta ịgụ ọnụ. A ga-egosi mkpịsị aka. Gụọ mkpịsị aka ndị e weliri elu, mgbe ahụ kwuo ọnụọgụ ahụ n'asụsụ Bekee.
en: Now we'll learn to count. Fingers will be shown. Count the fingers that are up, then say the number in English.

text: Ugbu a, anyị ga-ahụ foto ụgbọ njem. Anyị ga-amụta aha ha n'asụsụ Bekee.
en: Now we'll see pictures of vehicles. We'll learn their names in English.

text: Ị mere nke ọma!
en: Well done!

text: pịa bọọdụ ojii.
en: press the black slate.

text: Pịa foto ihe a kpọrọ aha ya.
en: Tap the picture of the thing that was named.

text: Mba, ọ bụghị nke ahụ. Gee ntị ọzọ, nwaa ọzọ.
en: No, not that one. Listen again, try again.

text: Ị mere nke ọma! Ugbu a, ị maala ịgụ ihe!
en: Well done! Now you can read!

text: Lee otu okwu. Anyị ga-agụ okwu a ọnụ. Mkpụrụedemede n'otu n'otu.
en: Here is a word. We'll read this word together. Letter by letter.

text: Ugbu a, gụọ okwu ahụ niile ọnụ, n'olu dị elu.
en: Now read the whole word, out loud.

text: Gee ntị, nke a bụ
en: Listen, this is

text: Mba, nwaa ọzọ.
en: No, try again.

text: Ugbu a, anyị ga-agwakọta ha.
en: Now we'll mix them up.

text: Ugbu a, dee ya n'asụsụ Bekee. Ụzọ abụọ dị.
en: Now write it in English. There are two ways.

text: Pịa ma ọ bụ kwuo mkpụrụedemede nke mbụ.
en: Tap or say the first letter.

text: Pịa ma ọ bụ kwuo mkpụrụedemede nke abụọ.
en: Tap or say the second letter.

text: Pịa ma ọ bụ kwuo mkpụrụedemede nke atọ.
en: Tap or say the third letter.

text: Pịa ma ọ bụ kwuo mkpụrụedemede nke anọ.
en: Tap or say the fourth letter.

text: Pịa ma ọ bụ kwuo mkpụrụedemede nke ise.
en: Tap or say the fifth letter.

text: Pịa ma ọ bụ kwuo mkpụrụedemede nke isii.
en: Tap or say the sixth letter.

text: Pịa ma ọ bụ kwuo mkpụrụedemede nke asaa.
en: Tap or say the seventh letter.

text: Pịa ma ọ bụ kwuo mkpụrụedemede nke asatọ.
en: Tap or say the eighth letter.

text: Pịa ma ọ bụ kwuo mkpụrụedemede nke itoolu.
en: Tap or say the ninth letter.

text: Pịa Chioma, kwuo mkpụrụedemede ahụ.
en: Press Chioma and say the letter.

text: Ma ọ bụ pịa mkpụrụedemede ọ bụla.
en: Or tap any letter.

text: Ị mere nke ọma! I mechaala ìgwè a.
en: Well done! You've finished this group.

text: Lee ihe ọmụmụ dị iche iche. Pịa foto ọ bụla ka ịmata ihe dị n'ime ya.
en: Here are the different lessons. Tap any picture to find out what's in it.

text: Dee ya, mkpụrụedemede n'otu n'otu.
en: Write it, letter by letter.

text: Ugbu a, ule! Dee nke ọ bụla, mkpụrụedemede n'otu n'otu.
en: Now, a test! Write each one, letter by letter.

text: Pịa Chioma ka anyị malite.
en: Press Chioma to start.

text: Nke a bụ
en: This is

text: Ma ọ bụghị ya,
en: If not,

text: Mgbe ọ bụla ịchọrọ ikwu okwu, pịa Chioma. Aga m ege ntị nke ọma!
en: Whenever you want to speak, press Chioma. I'll listen carefully!

text: Ndewo! Ọ bụrụ na ị bụ nwa agbọghọ, pịa nke ọcha. Ọ bụrụ na ị bụ nwa nwoke, pịa nke uhie.
en: Hello! If you are a girl, tap the white one. If you are a boy, tap the red one.

text: Pịa Chioma, mgbe ahụ kwuo mkpụrụedemede ị hụrụ.
en: Press Chioma, then say the letter you see.

text: Ihe dị iche iche. N'ebe a, anyị ga-amụta aha ihe n'asụsụ Bekee, site na foto.
en: Things. Here we learn the names of things in English, with pictures.

text: Ị mere nke ọma! Ugbu a, ị maala mkpụrụedemede na okwu niile.
en: Well done! Now you know all the letters and words.

text: Mmadụ nọ n'akụkụ gị. Biko, nọrọ naanị gị n'ihu kamera.
en: There is someone next to you. Please sit alone in front of the camera.

text.m: Ka ị laghachi azụ, pịa ụzọ a.
text.f: Ka ị laghachi azụ, pịa ụzọ a.

en: Welcome back!

text: Omume. Ihe ọmụmụ a bụ maka ihe anyị na-eme kwa ụbọchị. Dịka iri nri, ịṅụ mmiri, ịgba ọsọ na igwu egwu.
en: Actions. This lesson is about the things we do every day. Like eating, drinking, running and playing.

text: Uwe. Ihe ọmụmụ a bụ maka uwe anyị na-eyi.
en: Clothing. This lesson is about the clothes we wear.

text: Ndị mmadụ. Ihe ọmụmụ a bụ maka ndị mmadụ nọ gburugburu anyị. Mama, papa, ụmụaka na ndị nkuzi.
en: People. This lesson is about the people around us. Mum, dad, children and teachers.

text: Ụlọ akwụkwọ. Ihe ọmụmụ a bụ maka ihe anyị na-eji n'ụlọ akwụkwọ.
en: School. This lesson is about the things we use at school.

text: Ugbu a, anyị ga-ahụ foto omume. Anyị ga-amụta aha ha n'asụsụ Bekee.
en: Now we'll see pictures of actions. We'll learn their names in English.

text: Ugbu a, anyị ga-ahụ foto uwe. Anyị ga-amụta aha ha n'asụsụ Bekee.
en: Now we'll see pictures of clothes. We'll learn their names in English.

text: Ugbu a, anyị ga-ahụ foto ndị mmadụ. Anyị ga-amụta aha ha n'asụsụ Bekee.
en: Now we'll see pictures of people. We'll learn their names in English.

text: Ugbu a, anyị ga-ahụ foto ihe ụlọ akwụkwọ. Anyị ga-amụta aha ha n'asụsụ Bekee.
en: Now we'll see pictures of school things. We'll learn their names in English.

text: Bịaruo kamera nso.
en: Come closer to the camera.

text: Ka ị nụ ya ọzọ, pịa ntị a.
en: To hear it again, press this ear.

text: Ugbu a, pịa Chioma ka anyị malite.
en: Now press Chioma and we'll start.

text: Ịgụ ihe. N'ebe a, anyị ga-agụ okwu, mkpụrụedemede n'otu n'otu, mgbe ahụ okwu ahụ niile ọnụ.
en: Reading. Here we read words, letter by letter, then all at once.

text: Ugbu a, anyị ga-agụ aha ihe ndị a n'asụsụ Bekee.
en: Now we'll read the names of these things in English.

text: Ugbu a, anyị ga-eme obere ule maka okwu ị mụtara. A ga-egosi gị otu okwu, gụọ ya niile ọnụ.
en: Now we'll do a small test on the words you learned. A word will be shown, and you read it whole.

text: Okwu dị mkpụmkpụ. N'ebe a, anyị ga-agụ okwu dị mkpụmkpụ, nwere mkpụrụedemede atọ.
en: Short words. Here we read short, three-letter words.

text: Okwu dị n'etiti. N'ebe a, anyị ga-agụ okwu nwere mkpụrụedemede anọ na ise.
en: Medium words. Here we read four- and five-letter words.

text: Okwu dị ogologo. N'ebe a, anyị ga-agụ okwu dị ogologo.
en: Long words. Here we read long words.

text: Ọnụọgụ. N'ebe a, anyị ga-agụ aha ọnụọgụ n'asụsụ Bekee.
en: Numbers. Here we read the names of numbers in English.

text: Ugbu a, anyị ga-eme obere ule, ka anyị mara na ị ghọtara mkpụrụedemede ị mụtara.
en: Now we'll do a small test, to make sure you understood the letters you learned.

text: Nnukwu ule. Kwuo mkpụrụedemede niile, otu n'otu.
en: The big test. Say all the letters, one after another.

text: Ule ikpeazụ. A ga-agwakọta mkpụrụedemede ma gosi gị ha. Kwuo ha niile.
en: The last test. The letters will be shown mixed up; say them all.

text: Lee mkpụrụedemede anọ. Gee ntị, leba anya.
en: Here are four letters. Listen and look.

text: Ugbu a, ị ga-ahụ mkpụrụedemede ọhụrụ abụọ ị ga-amụta. Nke a bụ ọkwa ọhụrụ, nke dị ezigbo mkpa.
en: Now you'll see two new letters to learn. This is a new stage, a very important one.

text: Ugbu a, ị ga-ahụ mkpụrụedemede ọhụrụ anọ ị ga-amụta. Nke a bụ ọkwa ọhụrụ, nke dị ezigbo mkpa.
en: Now you'll see four new letters to learn. This is a new stage, a very important one.

text: Ugbu a, kwuo ya n'onwe gị.
en: Now you say it yourself.

text: Aha m bụ Chioma. Abụ m enyi gị n'ọmụmụ ihe. Ugbu a, pịa isi m ka anyị malite.
en: My name is Chioma. I'm your learning friend. Now press my head and we'll start.

text: Anyị ga-akwụsị ọmụmụ ihe a. Ọ bụrụ na i mechaala, pịa Chioma. Ma ọ bụghị ya, pịa bọọdụ ojii.
en: The session will end. If you are done, press Chioma. If not, press the black slate.

text: Chọta ebe ìhè dị karịa.
en: Find a brighter spot.

text: Biko, chere ntakịrị. A na-edozi ihe niile.
en: Please wait a little. Everything is getting ready.

text: Leba anya na kamera.
en: Look at the camera.

text: Ugbu a, nnukwu ule! Anyị ga-anwale ọnụọgụ niile ị mụtara, ka anyị mara na ị ma ha. A ga-egosi gị otu ọnụọgụ, a ga-akpọ aha ya n'asụsụ Igbo, mgbe ahụ gị onwe gị ga-akpọ aha ya n'asụsụ Bekee. Ọ bụrụ na i chefuola aha ya n'asụsụ Bekee,
en: Now the big test! We'll test all the numbers you learned, to make sure you know them. A number will be shown, its name said in Igbo, and you say its name in English. If you've forgotten its English name,

text: Ugbu a, anyị ga-amụgharị ndị siiri gị ike, ya na ụfọdụ ndị ị maara, ka anyị mekwuo ha ọzọ.
en: Now we'll learn again the ones you struggled with, together with a few you know, for extra practice.

text: Ugbu a, narị: narị abụọ, narị atọ, ruo narị itoolu, mgbe ahụ puku.
en: Now the hundreds: two hundred, three hundred, up to nine hundred, then a thousand.

text: N'ebe a, anyị ga-amụta ọnụọgụ. Nke mbụ, anyị ga-eji mkpịsị aka gụọ ọnụ, site na otu ruo iri. Mgbe ahụ, anyị ga-amụta akara ọnụọgụ.
en: Here we learn numbers. First we count on our fingers, one to ten. Then we learn the number signs.

text: Lee aka. Gụọ mkpịsị aka ndị e weliri elu.
en: Here is a hand. Count the fingers that are up.

text: Ugbu a, akara ọnụọgụ site na iri na otu ruo iri abụọ.
en: Now the number signs from eleven to twenty.

text: Ugbu a, anyị ga-amụta akara ọnụọgụ ndị ị mụtara, site na otu ruo iri.
en: Now we'll learn the signs of the numbers you learned, one to ten.

text: Ugbu a, anyị ga-amụta ọnụọgụ ndị buru ibu: iri atọ, iri anọ, iri ise, ruo narị.
en: Now we'll learn the big numbers: thirty, forty, fifty, up to a hundred.

text: Gee ntị ọzọ. N'asụsụ Bekee, ọ bụ:
en: Listen again. In English, it is:

text: Ị zara ha niile nke ọma! Ugbu a, anyị ga-aga n'ihu.
en: You got them all right! Now we go on.

text.m: Foto ndị ị ga-ahụ ugbu a bụ ndị siiri gị ike. Anyị ga-amụgharị ha.
text.f: Foto ndị ị ga-ahụ ugbu a bụ ndị siiri gị ike. Anyị ga-amụgharị ha.

en: The pictures you'll see now are the ones you struggled with. We'll learn them again.

text: Ị ga-emeli ya!
en: You can do it!

text: N'asụsụ Bekee, ọ bụ:
en: In English, it is:

text: Lee foto. Gee ntị, leba anya.
en: Here are three pictures. Listen and look.

text: Nke ahụ ezighi ezi. Ka anyị gaa n'ihu.
en: That one wasn't right. Let's go on.

text: Ugbu a, lee foto ise ọzọ.
en: Now here are five more pictures.

text: Ugbu a, ka anyị gaa na nke ọzọ.
en: Now, on to the next.

text: Ụfọdụ ezighi ezi. Anyị ga-amụgharị ha, mgbe ahụ anyị ga-eme ule ahụ ọzọ.
en: Some weren't right. We'll learn them again, then take the test again.

text: Lee ndị ị zara nke ọma:
en: Here are the ones you got right:

text: Kwuo ya n'asụsụ Bekee.
en: Say it in English.

text: Ugbu a, anyị ga-eme obere ule, ka anyị mara na ị ma ha. A ga-egosi gị otu foto, a ga-akpọ aha ya n'asụsụ Igbo, mgbe ahụ gị onwe gị ga-akpọ aha ya n'asụsụ Bekee. Ọ bụrụ na i chefuola aha ya n'asụsụ Bekee,
en: Now we'll do a small test, to make sure you know them. A picture will be shown, its name said in Igbo, and you say its name in English. If you've forgotten its English name,

text: Nke ahụ siri ike. Ugbu a, ka anyị gaa na nke ọzọ.
en: That one is hard. Now, on to the next.

text: Ọ bụ oge gị. Pịa Chioma, kpọọ aha ya n'asụsụ Bekee.
en: Your turn. Press Chioma and say its name in English.

text: Ndị a kwa, anyị ga-amụgharị ha:
en: And these, we'll learn again:

text.m: Anyị ga-ese vidiyo gị ka ị na-akpọ aha gị. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, ọ bụrụ na aha gị bụ Ebuka, sị: Aha m bụ Ebuka.
text.f: Anyị ga-ese vidiyo gị ka ị na-akpọ aha gị. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, ọ bụrụ na aha gị bụ Chichi, sị: Aha m bụ Chichi.

en: We will take a video of you saying your name. For example, if your name is Ebuka, say: Aha m bụ Ebuka.

text.any: Lee nwa nwoke aha ya bụ Ebuka. Ọ na-akpọ aha ya.
text.f: Lee nwa agbọghọ aha ya bụ Chichi. Ọ na-akpọ aha ya.

en: Here is the boy Ebuka / the girl Chichi, saying the name.

text: Ugbu a, ọ bụ oge gị. Pịa Chioma, mgbe ahụ gwa anyị aha gị.
en: Now you: press Chioma, then say your name.

text: Anyị chọrọ kamera na maikrofon ka ihe a rụọ ọrụ. Pịa 'Allow'.
en: We need the camera and the microphone for this to work. Tap 'Allow'.

text: E nyeghị ikike. Nwaa ọzọ, pịa 'Allow'.
en: Permission was not given. Try again and tap 'Allow'.

text: Ugbu a, ka anyị nwaa ọzọ, were ndị ọhụrụ. Gee ntị nke ọma.
en: Now let's play again, with new ones. Listen carefully.

text: Foto anọ. A ga-egosi gị foto anọ, a ga-akpọ aha otu n'ime ha n'asụsụ Bekee, mgbe ahụ pịa ya.
en: Four pictures. You'll see four pictures, one will be named in English, and you tap it.

text: Ọnụọgụ. A ga-akpọ otu ọnụọgụ n'asụsụ Bekee, mgbe ahụ pịa akara ya.
en: Numbers. A number will be said in English, and you tap its sign.

text: Pịa akara ọnụọgụ a kpọrọ.
en: Tap the sign of the number that was said.

text: N'ebe a, anyị ga-amụta ide aha ihe n'asụsụ Bekee, mkpụrụedemede n'otu n'otu. A ga-egosi gị foto, mgbe ahụ dee aha ya.
en: Here we learn to write the names of things in English, letter by letter. A picture will be shown, and you write its name.

text: Ọ bụ oge gị. Họrọ ihe ọmụmụ.
en: Your turn. Pick a lesson.

text: Ị mere nke ọma!
en: Well done!

text: Mkpụrụedemede atọ. N'ebe a, anyị ga-ede okwu nwere mkpụrụedemede atọ, n'otu n'otu.
en: Three letters. Here we write three-letter words, letter by letter.

text: Mkpụrụedemede anọ. N'ebe a, anyị ga-ede okwu nwere mkpụrụedemede anọ, n'otu n'otu.
en: Four letters. Here we write four-letter words, letter by letter.

text: Mkpụrụedemede ise. N'ebe a, anyị ga-ede okwu nwere mkpụrụedemede ise, n'otu n'otu.
en: Five letters. Here we write five-letter words, letter by letter.

text: Okwu dị ogologo. N'ebe a, anyị ga-ede okwu dị ogologo, mkpụrụedemede n'otu n'otu.
en: Long words. Here we write long words, letter by letter.

text: Ọnụọgụ. N'ebe a, anyị ga-ede aha ọnụọgụ n'asụsụ Bekee, mkpụrụedemede n'otu n'otu.
en: Numbers. Here we write the names of numbers in English, letter by letter.

text: Anaghị m ahụ gị nke ọma. Biko, ka anyị nwaa ọzọ.
en: I can't see you well. Please, let's try again.

text: Anụghị m aha gị nke ọma. Biko, ka anyị nwaa ọzọ.
en: I couldn't hear you say your name. Please, let's try again.

text: Pịa Chioma ka ị nwaa ọzọ.
en: Click Chioma to try again.

text: Ma ọ bụ pịa ụzọ a ka ị malitegharịa.
en: Or click this door to go back and start again.

text: Ndewo,
en: Hello,

text: Kwuo ya ugbu a.
en: Say it now.

text: Mkpụrụedemede nke mbụ bụ:
en: The first letter is:

text: Mkpụrụedemede nke abụọ bụ:
en: The second letter is:

text: Mkpụrụedemede nke atọ bụ:
en: The third letter is:

text: Mkpụrụedemede nke anọ bụ:
en: The fourth letter is:

text: Mkpụrụedemede nke ise bụ:
en: The fifth letter is:

text: Mkpụrụedemede nke isii bụ:
en: The sixth letter is:

text: Mkpụrụedemede nke asaa bụ:
en: The seventh letter is:

text: Mkpụrụedemede nke asatọ bụ:
en: The eighth letter is:

text: Mkpụrụedemede nke itoolu bụ:
en: The ninth letter is:

text: Pịa ya.
en: Tap it.

text: A na-ede ya otu a:
en: It is written like this:

text: Nọrọ jụụ.
en: Hold still.

text: Nnọọ!
en: Welcome!

text: Ọmụmaatụ! Lee anya, gee ntị ka e si eme ya.
en: Example! Watch and listen to how it's done.

text: Aga m agụ mkpụrụedemede ndị a, otu n'otu. Gee ntị.
en: I will read the letters, one by one. Listen.

text: Lee ihe m ga-ekwu:
en: Here is what I'll say:

text: Ọ bụ oge gị. Nwaa ya.
en: Your turn. Try it.

text: Aha m bụ Chioma. Abụ m enyi gị n'ọmụmụ ihe.
en: My name is Chioma. I am your learning friend.

text: Ọnụ, anyị ga-amụta asụsụ Bekee.
en: Together we are going to learn English.

text: Enwere m ihe ọmụmụ ndị mara mma nke ukwuu.
en: I have amazing lessons.

text: Anyị ga-amụta mkpụrụedemede Bekee.
en: We will learn the English alphabet.

text: Anyị ga-amụta ịgụ na ide ihe n'asụsụ Bekee.
en: We will learn to read and write in English.

text: Anyị ga-amụta ịgụ ọnụ.
en: We will learn to count.

text: Anyị ga-amụta aha ihe dịka anụmanụ na nri, n'asụsụ Bekee.
en: We will learn the names of things like animals and foods, in English.

text: Na ọtụtụ ihe ọzọ na-atọ ụtọ.
en: And many other amazing things.

text: Ị ga-enwe ike ịgwa m okwu. Aga m anọnyere gị.
en: You will be able to speak to me and I will be with you.

text: Obi dị m ụtọ ịhụ gị.
en: I am happy to see you.

text: Ugbu a, ka anyị gaa n'ihu site n'ebe anyị kwụsịrị.
en: Now let us continue from where we stopped.

text: Lee ihe ị ga-eme ka i kwuo ya n'asụsụ Bekee. Ị ga-apị Chioma, mgbe ahụ ị ga-asị:
en: Here is what you will do to say it in English. You will press Chioma, then you will say:

text: Lee ihe ị ga-eme ka ị gụọ ya n'asụsụ Bekee. Ị ga-apị Chioma, mgbe ahụ ị ga-agụ okwu a:
en: Here is what you will do to read it in English. You will press Chioma, then you will read the word:

text: Lee ihe ị ga-eme ka i dee ya n'asụsụ Bekee. Ị ga-apị Chioma, mgbe ahụ ị ga-ekwu mkpụrụedemede ndị a:
en: Here is what you will do to write it in English. You will press Chioma, then you will say the letters:

text: Lee ihe ị ga-eme. Gee ntị, mgbe ahụ pịa foto a kpọrọ aha ya.
en: Here is what you will do. Listen, then press the picture that was named.

text: Lee ihe ị ga-eme. Gee ntị, mgbe ahụ pịa akara ọnụọgụ a kpọrọ.
en: Here is what you will do. Listen, then press the number that was named.

text: Ugbu a, a ga-egosi gị foto anọ. Gee ntị n'aha a kpọrọ n'asụsụ Bekee, mgbe ahụ pịa ya.
en: Now you will be shown four pictures. Listen for the name said in English, then press it.

text: Ugbu a, a ga-egosi gị akara ọnụọgụ. Gee ntị n'ọnụọgụ a kpọrọ n'asụsụ Bekee, mgbe ahụ pịa ya.
en: Now you will be shown numbers. Listen for the one said in English, then press it.

text: Anyị ga-ekwu mkpụrụedemede ndị a, otu n'otu. Ụzọ abụọ dị.
en: We will say the letters one after another. There are two ways.

text: Nke mbụ, site n'olu.
en: The first, with your voice.

text: Nke abụọ, site na bọọdụ.
en: The second, with the board.

text: Mkpụrụedemede nke mbụ, aga m eji olu m kwuo ya.
en: The first letter, I will say with my voice.

text: Mkpụrụedemede nke abụọ kwa, aga m eji olu m kwuo ya.
en: The second letter too, I will say with my voice.

text: Mkpụrụedemede ikpeazụ, aga m apị ya na bọọdụ.
en: And the last letter, I will press it on the board.

text: Lee bọlụn ndị nwere mkpụrụedemede. Jiri mkpịsị aka gị pịa bọlụn, ọ ga-agbawa.
en: Here are balloons with letters. Press a balloon with your finger and it bursts.

text: Ị mere nke ọma, anyị emechaala egwuregwu a!
en: Well done, we've finished the game!

text: Lee ọmụmaatụ. Aga m agbawa nke mbụ:
en: Here is an example. I'll pop the first one:

text: Ugbu a, ọ bụ gị.
en: Now you.

text: Gbawaa mkpụrụedemede na-esote
en: Pop the letter after

text: Chọta mkpụrụedemede mbụ nke Bekee, gbawaa ya. Mgbe ahụ, nke na-esote ya, n'usoro.
en: Find the first letter of English and pop it. Then the letter after it, in order.

text: Aga m egosi gị ọzọ. Lezie anya.
en: I will show you again. Pay attention.

text: O zighi ezi, mana ị ga-amụta ya.
en: That was not right, but you will learn.

text: Ị nwere oge iji mechaa mkpụrụedemede niile, site na A ruo Z.
en: You have time to finish all the letters, A to Z.

text: Ọ bụrụ na i mee ya nke ọma, oge ga-abawanye. Ọ bụrụ na i mehie, oge ga-ebelata.
en: Get it right and time goes up. Get it wrong and time goes down.

text: Ọ bụrụ na oge agwụ, ị gaghị emeri. Ka ọ gaara gị nke ọma!
en: If the time runs out, you have not won. Good luck!

text: Oge agwụla. Ka anyị buru ụzọ mụta mkpụrụedemede.
en: Time is up. Let us learn the letters first.

text: Ị ma mkpụrụedemede niile.
en: You know your letters.

text: Ị ma mkpụrụedemede niile?
en: Do you know all the letters?

text: …ruo Z?
en: …all the way to Z?

text: Ọ bụrụ na ị ma ha, pịa Chioma. Ọ bụrụ na ị maghị ha, pịa bọọdụ ojii.
en: If you know them, tap Chioma. If you do not, tap the slate.

text: Echegbula onwe gị. Ka anyị buru ụzọ mụta ha.
en: Don't worry. Let us learn them first.

text: Anyị ga-egwu obere egwuregwu.
en: We are going to play a little game.

text: Ka ị malite, pịa akwụkwọ dị n'elu a ka ị malite ịmụ ihe.
en: To start, tap the book up here to begin learning.

text: Pịa akwụkwọ ahụ ka ị gaa n'ihu ịmụ ihe.
en: Tap the book to continue learning.

text: Ị nwekwara ike ịpị otu ihe ọmụmụ ka ị nụkwuo maka ya.
en: You can also press a lesson to hear more about it.

text: Gbawaa mkpụrụedemede mbụ:
en: Pop the first letter:

text: Gbawaa mkpụrụedemede na-esote.
en: Pop the next letter.

text: Anyị chọrọ ịma na ị ma mkpụrụedemede Bekee, dịka
en: We want to make sure you know the English letters, like

text: Ọ bụrụ na ị ma ha, pịa Chioma ka ị malite.
en: If you know them, tap Chioma to begin.

text: Ọ bụrụ na ị maghị ha, ọ dịghị nsogbu, anyị ga-amụkọ ha ọnụ. Pịa bọọdụ ojii ka ị malite ịmụ ihe.
en: If you don't, no problem, we will learn them together. Tap the black slate to begin learning.

text: Pịa mkpụrụ ụdara nwere ihe m kwuru tupu ọ daa n'ala.
en: Tap the udara fruit with the thing I say before it reaches the ground.

text: Lee foto a. Pịa Chioma, kwuo aha ya n'asụsụ Bekee, ka ihe nkiri malite!
en: Look at this picture. Tap Chioma, say its name in English, and the film will start!

text: Pịa wilbarọ na-ebu ihe m kwuru tupu ọ gafee.
en: Tap the wheelbarrow carrying the thing I say before it passes.

text: Gụọ okwu dị n'ụgbọala ọ bụla, wee pịa nke dabara na foto ahụ. Ọ ga-apụ n'ogige ahụ!
en: Read the word on each lorry, then tap the one that matches the picture. It will drive out of the park!

text: Ka anyị kee ọla aka! Pịa mkpụrụ aka nwere mkpụrụedemede okwu ahụ otu otu.
en: Let's string a coral necklace! Tap the beads with the word's letters one after another.

text: Kwuo mkpụrụedemede okwu ahụ otu otu, ma ọ bụ pịa ha. Mkpụrụedemede ọ bụla bụ otu iberibe ọjị n'okwa.
en: Say the letters of the word one by one, or press them. Each letter is one kola lobe in the bowl.

text: Ọ dịghị nsogbu! Ka anyị malite ịmụkọ ihe ọnụ. Pịa Chioma ka ị gaa n'ihu.
en: No problem! Let's start learning together. Tap Chioma to continue.

text: Pịa Chioma ka ị gaa n'ihu.
en: Tap Chioma to continue.

text: Kwuo mkpụrụedemede nwata ahụ jidere n'asụsụ Bekee, ọ ga-abanye n'egwu ọnwa.
en: Say the letter the child is holding in English, and they will join the moonlight play.

text: Nke a bụ ka egwuregwu a si aga: kwuo mkpụrụedemede ị hụrụ na ọkọlọtọ ahụ, ka obi dị Obi ụtọ.
en: Here is how the game works: say the letter you see on the banner, so the Obi is happy.

text: Ugbu a, pịa Chioma ka anyị malite.
en: Now press Chioma and we'll start.

text: Kwuo aha ihe si n'akpa ahụ pụta n'asụsụ Bekee, ọ ga-aga n'aka Nne.
en: Say the name of the thing that comes out of the bag in English, and it goes to Nne.

text: Onye na-azụ ahịa abịala! Lee ihe ọ chọrọ, pịa Chioma, kwuo aha ya n'asụsụ Bekee, onye na-ere okpa ga-enye ya.
en: A customer is here! Look at what they want, press Chioma and say its name in English, and the okpa seller will give it to them.

text: Pịa ịtụ nke na-eme ọnụ ọgụgụ m kwuru, a ga-eji mmanụ nkwụ juo ha.
en: Tap the keg that makes the number I say, and they will be filled with palm oil.

text: Pịa igbe akpụkpọ ụkwụ nke ọnụ ahịa ya bụ nke m kwuru.
en: Tap the shoe box whose price is the one I say.

text: Gụọ ji ndị dị n'ute ahụ, wee kwuo ole ha dị n'asụsụ Bekee.
en: Count the yams on the mat and say how many in English.

text: Nke a bụ ka egwuregwu a si aga: gụọ ehi ndị dị n'ogige ahụ, wee kwuo ole ha dị n'asụsụ Bekee.
en: Here is how the game works: count the cows in the pen, then say how many in English.

text: Kwuo ego ole Oga jidere n'asụsụ Bekee.
en: Say how much money the Oga is holding, in English.

text: Gụọ okwu dị na mgbidi ahụ n'olu dara ụda, onye ese ga-eme ya uli.
en: Read the word on the wall out loud, and the painter will turn it into uli.

text: Gụọ aha ọdụ ụgbọ oloko ahụ n'olu dara ụda, ụgbọ oloko ga-akwụsị.
en: Read the station board out loud, and the train will stop.

text: Kwuo mkpụrụedemede okwu ahụ otu otu, ma ọ bụ pịa ha, onye na-ebi akwụkwọ ga-edobe ha n'igwe obibi akwụkwọ.
en: Say the letters of the word one by one, or press them, and the printer will set them in the press.

text: Gụọ okwu dị na bọọdụ ahụ n'olu dara ụda, onye mgba gị ga-atụda onye nke ọzọ.
en: Read the word on the board out loud, and your wrestler will throw the other one.

text: Kwuo mkpụrụedemede okwu ahụ otu otu, ma ọ bụ pịa ha. Mkpụrụedemede ọ bụla ga-akpa otu ahịrị n'akwa ahụ.
en: Say the letters of the word one by one, or press them. Each letter weaves one row into the cloth.

text: Ugbu a, ka anyị jiri mkpụrụedemede ị mụtara gwuo egwuregwu!
en: Now let's play a game with the letters you've learned!

text: Ọ fọrọ obere! Ka anyị nwaa ọzọ.
en: You were close! Let's try once more.

text: Ugbu a, ị nwere ike igwu egwuregwu a mgbe ọ bụla ịchọrọ, site na peeji mbụ.
en: Now you can play this game whenever you like, from the home page.

text: Ị mere nke ọma! Ị nwetala kpakpando atọ na ọlaedo iri ise.
en: Well done! You earned three stars and 50 gold.

text: Ị mere nke ọma! Ị nwetala kpakpando atọ na ọlaedo otu narị.
en: Well done! You earned three stars and 100 gold.

text: Ị mere nke ọma! Ị nwetala kpakpando atọ na ọlaedo otu narị na iri ise.
en: Well done! You earned three stars and 150 gold.

text: Ị mere nke ọma! Ị nwetala kpakpando atọ na ọlaedo narị abụọ.
en: Well done! You earned three stars and 200 gold.

text: Ị mere nke ọma! Ị nwetala kpakpando anọ na ọlaedo iri ise.
en: Well done! You earned four stars and 50 gold.

text: Ị mere nke ọma! Ị nwetala kpakpando anọ na ọlaedo otu narị.
en: Well done! You earned four stars and 100 gold.

text: Ị mere nke ọma! Ị nwetala kpakpando anọ na ọlaedo otu narị na iri ise.
en: Well done! You earned four stars and 150 gold.

text: Ị mere nke ọma! Ị nwetala kpakpando anọ na ọlaedo narị abụọ.
en: Well done! You earned four stars and 200 gold.

text: Ugbu a, ị bụzi Onye Obi!
en: Now you are a Onye Obi!

text: Ugbu a, ị bụzi Dike!
en: Now you are a Dike!

text: Ugbu a, ị bụzi Onye Nkuzi!
en: Now you are a Onye Nkuzi!

text: Ugbu a, ị bụzi Nwa Eze!
en: Now you are a Nwa Eze!

text: Ugbu a, ị bụzi Onye Nketa!
en: Now you are a Onye Nketa!

text: Ugbu a, ị bụzi Eze!
en: Now you are a Eze!

text: Mgbalị gị ewetala gị n'ọkwa ọhụrụ!
en: Your effort has brought you to a new level!

text: Akpa ọlaedo gị mbụ ejupụtala!
en: Your first bag of gold is full!

text: Akpa ọlaedo gị nke abụọ ejupụtala!
en: Your second bag of gold is full!

text: Akpa ọlaedo gị nke atọ ejupụtala!
en: Your third bag of gold is full!

text: Akpa ọlaedo gị nke anọ ejupụtala!
en: Your fourth bag of gold is full!

text: Akpa ọlaedo gị nke ise ejupụtala!
en: Your fifth bag of gold is full!

text: Ọlaedo gị eruola otu puku.
en: Your gold has reached 1,000.

text: Ọlaedo gị eruola puku abụọ.
en: Your gold has reached 2,000.

text: Ọlaedo gị eruola puku anọ.
en: Your gold has reached 4,000.

text: Ọlaedo gị eruola puku isii.
en: Your gold has reached 6,000.

text: Ọlaedo gị eruola puku asatọ.
en: Your gold has reached 8,000.

text: Ọlaedo gị eruola puku iri.
en: Your gold has reached 10,000.

text: Ọlaedo gị eruola puku iri na abụọ.
en: Your gold has reached 12,000.

text: Ọlaedo gị eruola puku iri na isii.
en: Your gold has reached 16,000.

text: Nke a bụ ọkwa mbụ. Ọkwa anọ ọzọ dị n'ihu.
en: This is the first level. There are four more levels ahead.

text: Nọgide na-agba mbọ, ruo mgbe ị ghọrọ Eze!
en: Keep trying, until you become an Eze!

text: Nọgide na-agba mbọ otu a!
en: Keep up the effort like this!

text: Nke a bụ ọkwa kachasị elu!
en: This is the highest level of all!

text: Na-amụ ihe kwa ụbọchị!
en: Keep learning every day!
